name: Russia
title: Russian Golden & Silver Age
tagline: Profound philosophical realism, existential anguish, and the enigmatic Russian soul.

books.title: Crime and Punishment
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.description: A destitute former student in Saint Petersburg formulates a theory of extraordinary men who are permitted to commit crimes, leading him to murder a pawnbroker and enter a harrowing mental descent.

books.title: The Brothers Karamazov
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.description: A passionate philosophical novel exploring faith, doubt, morality, and patricide through the tumultuous lives of three disparate brothers and their tyrannical father.

books.title: War and Peace
books.author: Leo Tolstoy
books.description: A monumental epic delineating Russian society during the Napoleonic invasion through the intertwined destinies of the aristocratic Bezukhov, Bolkonsky, and Rostov families.

books.title: Anna Karenina
books.author: Leo Tolstoy
books.description: A sweeping panorama of 19th-century imperial Russian society contrasting the doomed romance of the aristocratic Anna with Levin's quest for rural spiritual contentment.

books.title: The Master and Margarita
books.author: Mikhail Bulgakov
books.description: The Devil arrives in atheistic 1930s Moscow with a talking black cat and a troupe of demonic performers, unleashing surreal chaos while interwoven with the trial of Pontius Pilate.

books.title: The Idiot
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.description: Prince Myshkin, a gentle and saintly nobleman suffering from epilepsy, returns to decadent Saint Petersburg, where his purity is misinterpreted as idiocy.

books.title: Eugene Onegin
books.author: Alexander Pushkin
books.description: The foundational masterpiece of Russian verse literature, chronicling a jaded young dandy who rejects the devoted love of Tatyana, only to realize his fatal error too late.

books.title: Doctor Zhivago
books.author: Boris Pasternak
books.description: The epic story of physician and poet Yuri Zhivago torn between the turmoil of the Russian Revolution and his transcendent love for Lara.

books.title: Dead Souls
books.author: Nikolai Gogol
books.description: Pavel Chichikov travels through provincial Russia purchasing the legal rights to deceased serfs ('dead souls') to pull off an audacious mortgage scheme.

books.title: Fathers and Sons
books.author: Ivan Turgenev
books.description: The enigmatic student Bazarov introduces the philosophy of radical nihilism to a traditional Russian country estate, igniting a fierce generational clash.

name: United Kingdom
title: British Literary Canon
tagline: Victorian drama, modern dystopias, gothic romance, and timeless social observation.

books.author: George Orwell
books.description: Winston Smith lives in a perpetual surveillance nightmare ruled by the totalitarian Party and Big Brother, daring to commit the mortal sin of independent thought and forbidden love.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: The spirited Elizabeth Bennet navigates the intricate social codes of 19th-century England, clashing with and slowly understanding the haughty Mr. Darcy.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.author: Mary Shelley
books.description: Obsessed natural scientist Victor Frankenstein breathes life into a creature made of scavenged corpse fragments, unleashing catastrophic psychological consequences.

books.title: Great Expectations
books.author: Charles Dickens
books.description: The orphan Pip rises from humble blacksmith apprentice to wealthy London gentleman under the aegis of a mysterious anonymous benefactor.

books.title: Wuthering Heights
books.author: Emily Brontë
books.description: A tempestuous tale of passion, cruelty, and spectral revenge on the bleak Yorkshire moors between Catherine Earnshaw and the foundling Heathcliff.

books.title: Jane Eyre
books.author: Charlotte Brontë
books.description: An orphaned governess fights for personal independence and moral integrity while falling for the brooding Edward Rochester, keeper of a dark secret.

books.title: Brave New World
books.author: Aldous Huxley
books.description: A futuristic World State engineered through conditioned caste embryos, hedonistic pleasures, and soma drugs is challenged by an outsider from a savage reservation.

books.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.description: The modest hobbit Frodo Baggins inherits the Dark Lord Sauron's One Ring and embarks upon a perilous odyssey across Middle-earth to destroy it.

books.title: Mrs Dalloway
books.author: Virginia Woolf
books.description: A single post-war June day in London following Clarissa Dalloway as she prepares a society party, interwoven with shell-shocked veteran Septimus Warren Smith.

books.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.description: Master consulting detective Sherlock Holmes and Dr. John Watson untangle baffling mysteries, bizarre conspiracies, and criminal masterminds.

name: France
title: French Grand Literature & Existentialism
tagline: Enlightenment philosophy, existential truth, romantic grand epics, and psychological memory.

books.title: The Stranger
books.author: Albert Camus
books.description: Meursault, an emotionally detached French clerk in Algiers, is drawn into a senseless murder on a scorching beach and tried for his refusal to conform to society's emotional illusions.

books.title: Les Misérables
books.author: Victor Hugo
books.description: Paroled convict Jean Valjean seeks redemption and adopts the orphaned Cosette while relentlessly pursued by the unforgiving Inspector Javert through 19th-century revolutionary Paris.

books.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.description: Falsely imprisoned for 14 years in the sinister Château d'If, Edmond Dantès escapes, unearths a vast treasure, and constructs an elaborate labyrinth of vengeance.

books.title: In Search of Lost Time
books.author: Marcel Proust
books.description: A monumental multi-volume meditation on involuntary memory, art, aristocratic French society, and the elusive passage of time sparked by a madeleine steeped in tea.

books.title: Madame Bovary
books.author: Gustave Flaubert
books.description: Emma Bovary, stifled by provincial marriage to an earnest doctor, pursues romantic fantasies and ruinous extramarital liaisons in a desperate bid to escape banal reality.

books.title: The Little Prince
books.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
books.description: An aviator stranded in the Sahara encounters an enchanting boy from Asteroid B-612 who teaches him that what is most essential is invisible to the eye.

books.title: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
books.author: Jules Verne
books.description: Professor Aronnax is taken captive aboard the advanced submarine Nautilus commanded by the mysterious, vengeful genius Captain Nemo.

books.title: Candide
books.author: Voltaire
books.description: The naive Candide journeys across a brutal, earthquake-ravaged world while testing his tutor Pangloss's relentless optimism that all is for the best.

name: Japan
title: Japanese Classical & Modern Literature
tagline: Wabi-sabi beauty, surreal magical realism, post-war existential melancholia, and deep human solitude.

books.title: Norwegian Wood
books.author: Haruki Murakami
books.description: Toru Watanabe reflects back on his turbulent 1960s college days in Tokyo, torn between his emotional devotion to the fragile Naoko and the vibrant Midori.

books.title: No Longer Human
books.author: Osamu Dazai
books.description: The harrowing semi-autobiographical notebooks of Yozo, a troubled young man who hides his utter detachment from humanity behind a facade of buffoonery.

books.title: The Temple of the Golden Pavilion
books.author: Yukio Mishima
books.description: Based on the real 1950 burning of Kyoto's famous Kinkaku-ji temple by an acolyte obsessed with purifying beauty from an imperfect world.

books.title: Kokoro
books.author: Natsume Sōseki
books.description: A profound exploration of isolation, generational change, and remorse during Japan's transition to modernity, centered around an enigmatic mentor known as Sensei.

books.title: Snow Country
books.author: Yasunari Kawabata
books.description: A Tokyo dilettante travels to a remote hot-spring town beyond the mountain tunnel, entering a transient, bittersweet affair with a rural geisha.

books.title: Kafka on the Shore
books.author: Haruki Murakami
books.description: Fifteen-year-old runaway Kafka Tamura's fate intersects with Nakata, an aging simpleton who can converse with cats, in a dreamscape of raining fish and spirit lovers.

books.title: Rashomon and Other Stories
books.author: Ryūnosuke Akutagawa
books.description: The seminal stories of conflicting subjective truths and desperate moral survival under the ruined gates of ancient Kyoto.

name: Colombia
title: Colombian Magical Realism & Latin Boom
tagline: Labyrinthine dynasties, timeless romance, yellow butterflies, and enchanted memory.

books.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
books.author: Gabriel García Márquez
books.description: The monumental rise and fall of the mythical town of Macondo through seven generations of the eccentric, solitary Buendía family.

books.title: Love in the Time of Cholera
books.author: Gabriel García Márquez
books.description: Florentino Ariza waits over half a century through numerous affairs for the woman he adores, rekindling their passion after her husband's death.

books.title: Chronicle of a Death Foretold
books.author: Gabriel García Márquez
books.description: A gripping retrospective investigation into the publicly announced murder of Santiago Nasar by the Vicario brothers to restore their sister's honor.

books.title: The Autumn of the Patriarch
books.author: Gabriel García Márquez
books.description: A dense poetic dissection of absolute corruption following an eternal Caribbean dictator who sells the sea to foreigners and outlives memory.

name: Nigeria
title: Nigerian Literary Renaissance

books.title: Things Fall Apart
books.author: Chinua Achebe
books.description: Okonkwo, a fiercely proud Igbo warrior and wrestling champion, battles to preserve his society's ancestral traditions against the encroachment of British colonial rule.

books.title: Half of a Yellow Sun
books.author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
books.description: Five intertwined lives are irrevocably swept up in the idealism and devastating reality of the 1960s Nigerian-Biafran Civil War.

books.title: Death and the King's Horseman
books.author: Wole Soyinka
books.description: When a Yoruba king dies, his chief horseman must commit ritual suicide to accompany him to the afterlife, but British colonial intervention triggers cosmic catastrophe.

books.title: The Famished Road
books.author: Ben Okri
books.description: Azaro, an abiku spirit child born into the slums of pre-independence Nigeria, chooses to stay in the painful mortal world despite the spirits beckoning him back.

books.title: Americanah
books.author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
books.description: Teenage sweethearts Ifemelu and Obinze are separated when she immigrates to America and he is plunged into undocumented London life, before reuniting in a transformed Nigeria.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

books.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
books.author: Harper Lee
books.description: Lawyer Atticus Finch defends Tom Robinson, a Black man falsely accused of raping a white woman, through the innocent eyes of his young daughter Scout.

books.title: Moby-Dick; or, The Whale

books.description: Narrator Ishmael boards the doomed whaling ship Pequod, commanded by the monomaniacal Captain Ahab on his vendetta against the white sperm whale Moby Dick.

books.title: Beloved

books.title: The Old Man and the Sea
books.author: Ernest Hemingway
books.description: Aging Cuban fisherman Santiago ventures alone far into the Gulf Stream, hooking a giant marlin and engaging in an epic battle of endurance and dignity.

books.title: The Grapes of Wrath
books.author: John Steinbeck
books.description: Driven from their Dust Bowl farm, the Joad family travels west on Route 66 to California seeking employment, meeting prejudice and grueling exploitation.

books.title: The Sound and the Fury

books.description: The tragic disintegration of the aristocratic Compson family depicted through four innovative narrative perspectives across three decades in Mississippi.

books.title: The Road
books.author: Cormac McCarthy
books.description: A nameless father and his young son walk alone through a burned, ash-shrouded American wasteland pushing a shopping cart toward the southern coast.

name: Germany

books.title: The Metamorphosis
books.author: Franz Kafka
books.description: Traveling salesman Gregor Samsa wakes up one morning from uneasy dreams to discover he has been transformed into a monstrous insect.

books.title: Faust
books.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
books.description: Disillusioned scholar Heinrich Faust makes a fateful wager with the demon Mephistopheles, offering his soul in exchange for boundless worldly knowledge and sensual experience.

books.title: Siddhartha
books.author: Hermann Hesse
books.description: A wealthy young Brahmin in ancient India embarks on a lifelong spiritual pilgrimage through asceticism, sensual indulgence, and listening to the river.

books.title: All Quiet on the Western Front

books.title: The Trial
books.author: Franz Kafka
books.description: Bank clerk Josef K. is unexpectedly arrested one morning by shadowy wardens for a crime that is never revealed to him in an impenetrable court labyrinth.

name: Ireland
title: Irish Literary Giants

books.title: Ulysses
books.author: James Joyce
books.description: A revolutionary tour-de-force capturing June 16, 1904 in Dublin through the wandering footsteps and unfiltered inner monologues of Leopold Bloom.

books.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
books.author: Oscar Wilde
books.description: A handsome young man sells his soul so that a painted portrait will age and bear the hideous burden of his sins while he remains perpetually youthful.

books.title: Dracula
books.author: Bram Stoker
books.description: Solicitor Jonathan Harker travels to Count Dracula's castle in Transylvania, setting off an invasion of Victorian England by the undead warlord.

books.title: Waiting for Godot

books.title: Dubliners

books.description: The quintessential treatise on political statecraft, analyzing how rulers acquire, consolidate, and maintain power through pragmatic realism.

name: Argentina

books.title: Ficciones
books.author: Jorge Luis Borges

books.title: The Aleph and Other Stories

books.description: Centered on a point in space in a Buenos Aires basement from which all other points in the universe can be viewed simultaneously without confusion.

books.title: Hopscotch
books.author: Julio Cortázar
books.description: An open-ended, non-linear masterpiece that invites the reader to hop between chapters or follow an alternate table of instructions.

name: India

books.title: Midnight's Children

books.title: The God of Small Things

books.title: Gitanjali
books.author: Rabindranath Tagore
books.description: Profoundly lyrical devotional poem offerings celebrating divine communion, nature, and the spiritual awakening of the human soul.

books.title: The Three-Body Problem
books.author: Liu Cixin
books.description: During China's Cultural Revolution, a secret military project sends signals into space, contacting a dying trinary star civilization that plots invasion.

books.title: Dream of the Red Chamber

books.title: Red Sorghum

books.title: A Doll's House

name: Chile

books.title: The House of the Spirits

books.author: Roberto Bolaño
books.description: A towering five-part epic tracing four literary academics searching for an elusive German author, converged in the desert city haunted by unsolved murders.

books.title: Twenty Love Poems and a Song of Despair
books.author: Pablo Neruda
books.description: Neruda's celebrated cycle of incandescent, melancholy love poems capturing the raw passion and desolation of youthful romance.

books.title: The Posthumous Memoirs of Brás Cubas

books.title: The Hour of the Star

books.title: The Alchemist

books.description: The mystical tale of Santiago, an Andalusian shepherd boy who journeys to the pyramids of Egypt following his recurring dream of hidden treasure.

books.title: Palace Walk (The Cairo Trilogy)

books.title: Children of Gebelawi

books.title: The Yacoubian Building

books.title: Shahnameh: The Persian Book of Kings

books.description: A pen-case painter descends into macabre hallucinations and existential dread, addressing his confessions to his own owl-shaped shadow.

books.title: The Handmaid's Tale

authors: Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz

books.title: The Death of Artemio Cruz

books.title: The Vegetarian
books.author: Han Kang
books.description: After a terrifying blood-soaked nightmare, a docile housewife resolves to renounce meat, triggering an escalating familial rupture and metamorphosis toward plant life.

books.title: Human Acts
books.author: Han Kang
books.description: A harrowing, tender exploration of the brutal 1980 Gwangju Democratic Uprising told through the intertwined voices of victims and grieving survivors.

books.title: Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982
books.author: Cho Nam-Joo
books.description: A clinical yet deeply moving depiction of everyday structural misogyny in South Korea through the life story of an ordinary millennial mother.

name: Peru
title: Andean Realism & Power
tagline: Scathing deconstructions of authoritarianism, military culture, and rich indigenous tapestry.

books.title: The Time of the Hero
books.author: Mario Vargas Llosa
books.description: Cadets in Lima's Leoncio Prado Military Academy form a clandestine ring of rebellion that ends in theft, murder, and institutional cover-up.

books.title: Conversation in the Cathedral
books.author: Mario Vargas Llosa
books.description: Over drinks at a gritty Lima bar named The Cathedral, two men reconstruct the pervasive corruption and spiritual degradation under general Odría's dictatorship.

books.title: Deep Rivers
books.author: José María Arguedas
books.description: A sensitive boy raised among indigenous Quechua communities is placed into a boarding school, torn between two conflicting worlds during a feverish plague.

name: Czechia
title: Bohemian Irony & Kafkaesque Shadows
tagline: Surreal labyrinthine bureaucracy, playful philosophical eroticism, and anti-totalitarian wit.

books.title: The Unbearable Lightness of Being
books.author: Milan Kundera
books.description: During the 1968 Prague Spring, a surgeon, an artist, a photographer, and a dog confront eternal recurrence, personal liberty, and the lightness of fate.

books.title: The Metamorphosis
books.author: Franz Kafka
books.description: Gregor Samsa wakes one morning from uneasy dreams to find himself transformed into a monstrous vermin, confronting human absurdity.

books.title: Too Loud a Solitude
books.author: Bohumil Hrabal
books.description: For thirty-five years, Hanta has worked in a damp cellar compacting banned books into paper bales, accidentally absorbing centuries of world philosophy.

name: Portugal
title: Lusitanian Saudade & Allegory
tagline: Haunting oceanic nostalgia, visionary heteronyms, and Nobel-crowned human allegories.

books.title: Blindness
books.author: José Saramago
books.description: A city is gripped by an inexplicable epidemic of 'white blindness'; quarantined patients descend into chaos as only one woman retains her sight.

books.title: The Book of Disquiet
books.author: Fernando Pessoa
books.description: A monumental mosaic of introspective reflections, melancholia, and existential lucidity left in a trunk by Lisbon assistant bookkeeper Bernardo Soares.

books.title: The Maias
books.author: Eça de Queirós
books.description: A dazzling, satirical chronicle of the decline of a noble Portuguese lineage, intertwining romantic tragedy with biting portraits of aristocratic Lisbon.

name: Austria
title: Viennese Fin-de-Siècle & Memory
tagline: The golden twilight of the Habsburg empire, psychological depth, and crystalline nostalgia.

books.title: The World of Yesterday
books.author: Stefan Zweig
books.description: Zweig's breathtaking eulogy to the golden age of European culture and cosmopolitan Vienna before it was shattered by two world wars.

books.title: The Man Without Qualities
books.author: Robert Musil
books.description: A razor-sharp, satirical tour-de-force set in 1913 Austro-Hungarian 'Kakania' dissecting the intellectual illusions on the eve of civilizational collapse.

books.title: Chess Story
books.author: Stefan Zweig
books.description: On an ocean liner heading to Buenos Aires, a world chess champion is challenged by a mysterious passenger who mastered the game during solitary confinement.

name: Sweden
title: Nordic Mystery & Human Soul
tagline: Bleak psychological drama, Nordic noir pioneer, and folkloric Nobel triumphs.

books.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
books.author: Stieg Larsson
books.description: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist and genius hacker Lisbeth Salander uncover a dark family conspiracy of murder on a secluded Swedish island.

books.title: The Red Room
books.author: August Strindberg
books.description: A scathing, witty portrait of bohemian Stockholm society following a young civil servant who abandons government work to pursue art.

books.title: The Wonderful Adventures of Nils
books.author: Selma Lagerlöf
books.description: Shrunk to the size of a thumb for mischief, young Nils Holgersson flies across the breathtaking Swedish landscape on the back of a domestic gander.

name: Kenya
title: Rift Valley Epic & Decolonization
tagline: Anticolonial struggle, the Mau Mau rebellion, and linguistic cultural reclamation.

books.title: A Grain of Wheat
books.author: Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o
books.description: In the tense days leading to Kenya's 1963 independence, villagers confront hidden betrayals, wartime compromises, and the elusive nature of freedom.

books.title: Decolonising the Mind
books.author: Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o
books.description: Ngũgĩ's celebrated manifesto advocating the revival and supremacy of native African languages over European colonial tongues in literature.

books.title: Petals of Blood
books.author: Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o
books.description: A devastating murder inquiry in the rural town of Ilmorog exposes the neocolonial economic exploitation of ordinary post-independence Kenyans.

name: Cuba
title: Antillean Baroque & Real Maravilloso
tagline: Caribbean rhythms, magical marvels of history, and sensual revolutionary nostalgia.

books.title: The Kingdom of This World
books.author: Alejo Carpentier
books.description: The pioneering masterpiece defining 'lo real maravilloso' (the marvelous real), dramatizing the slave rebellions and black monarchy of Haiti.

books.title: Three Trapped Tigers
books.author: Guillermo Cabrera Infante
books.description: A dazzling, neon-soaked linguistic rollercoaster celebrating pre-revolutionary Havana's legendary cabaret nightlife, boleros, and nightlife camaraderie.

books.title: Paradiso
books.author: José Lezama Lima
books.description: A lush, hermetic tour-de-force chronicling young José Cemí's poetic education amidst family myths, secret societies, and Catholic mysticism.

name: Indonesia
title: Nusantara Archipelago Epics
tagline: The monumental Buru quartet, anticolonial awakening, and rich island polyphony.

books.title: This Earth of Mankind
books.author: Pramoedya Ananta Toer
books.description: Composed orally while imprisoned on Buru Island, this masterpiece depicts Minke, a Javanese aristocrat, awakening to Dutch colonial injustice.

books.title: Beauty is a Wound
books.author: Eka Kurniawan
books.description: A renowned concubine rises from the grave twenty-one years after her death to recount Indonesia's turbulent history through her daughters' cursed fates.

name: Netherlands
title: Dutch Golden & Moral Realism
tagline: Existential moral dilemmas, WWII memory, and anticolonial satire.

books.title: The Discovery of Heaven
books.author: Harry Mulisch
books.description: Frustrated with human corruption, angels plot to retrieve the stone Tablets of the Law by orchestrating the birth of an extraordinary genius child.

books.title: The Assault
books.author: Harry Mulisch
books.description: In 1945 occupied Holland, a Nazi collaborator is assassinated outside a house; the survivor spends his life unraveling why his innocent family was executed.

books.title: Max Havelaar
books.author: Multatuli
books.description: The groundbreaking Dutch novel that exposed the scandalous exploitation of the colonial coffee plantation system in the Dutch East Indies.

name: Iceland
title: Saga Island & Arctic Soul
tagline: Ancient medieval sagas, fierce independence, and Nobel-winning arctic poetry.

books.title: Independent People
books.author: Halldór Laxness
books.description: Sheep farmer Bjartur of Summerhouses battles devastating elements, ghosts, debt, and his own bull-headed stubbornness to remain a truly free man.

books.title: The Blue Fox
books.author: Sjón
books.description: A priest stalks an elusive blue fox through a harsh winter wasteland, in an enchanting fable steeped in Icelandic folklore and metamorphosis.
